clips.title: The story
paras: A Donation of Wool is a material requisition organized by the Gnomeregan Exiles to gather essential textile supplies. Displaced from their technological home city, the exiled gnomes rely on sixty pieces of wool cloth from generous adventurers across the realm to sustain their community. Contributing to the drive grants formal recognition among the gnome refugees.

Following the fall of Gnomeregan to trogg invaders and radioactive contamination, the surviving gnomes found themselves displaced from their high-tech metropolis. Operating as refugees primarily hosted by their dwarven cousins in Ironforge, the Gnomeregan Exiles face severe logistical strain. Routine material drives for basic goods like cloth are essential to keep their people clothed, supplied, and organized while surviving outside their ancestral halls.

To avoid overtaxing individual benefactors, the organizers of the drive request exactly sixty pieces of wool cloth per volunteer. By pooling modest contributions from across the realm, the exiles can amass the bulk textiles required for bedding, bandages, and clothing without placing an unsustainable burden on any single supplier. In exchange, the gnomes offer formal recognition among their people to anyone willing to aid their recovery effort.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
